name: com.dreamtech.uicore
description: Modular UI framework with UniTask backend. Plug-in animation & behavior modules via Inspector. Polished card-based editor with accordion module list, searchable subclass dropdown, theme-aware styles. Includes AnimatedButton, AnimatedToggle, AdvancedProgressBar, ButtonFeedback (press feedback for existing uGUI buttons with shared profiles, scroll-aware presses and a sound/haptic cue hook) and virtual scrolling (VirtualListView / VirtualGridView: recycling, measured sizes, snapping, nested scroll, edit-mode preview editor).
